semiconductor_relevance: High — Shimane University is involved in the development of innovative semiconductor materials and processes, particularly focusing on ZnO nanoparticles for LEDs and TFTs.
summary: Shimane University's Fujita-Yoshida Lab specializes in the research and development of semiconductor materials, particularly zinc oxide (ZnO) nanoparticles. They have pioneered a novel process for fabricating low-cost LEDs and thin-film transistors using these nanoparticles, which exhibit properties akin to single crystals.
capabilities: MOCVD technology for zinc oxide thin film growth
